name: Cable Seated Single-Arm Row
steps: Sit upright on a seated row bench with knees slightly bent, feet braced on the footplates, and one hand holding a single handle.
Brace your core, keep your shoulders square, and let your working arm extend forward into a controlled lat stretch.
Pull the handle smoothly toward your lower ribs by driving your elbow close to your side and squeezing your lat.
Extend your arm slowly back to the start without twisting your torso, then switch sides after completing one arm.
tips: Keep your chest facing forward and resist leaning back or twisting as you pull.
Drive your elbow straight back toward your hip rather than shrugging your shoulder upward.
